author: OPR-Project
description: The Oxford RobotCar Dataset is an autonomous driving dataset collected between May 2014 and December 2015.Between May 2014 and December 2015, we drove a route through Oxford city centre on average twice a week using the Oxford RobotCar platform, an autonomous Nissan LEAF vehicle. As a result, more than 1,000 km of traffic data was recorded, with almost 20 million images collected from six cameras mounted on the car, along with data from LIDAR, GPS, and INS.
